items.name: AAA battery pack and batteries
items.why: Powers the micro:bit when it is unplugged from the laptop for a task.

items.name: graph paper pad
items.why: For spatial puzzles, grids and sketching the design loop by hand.

items.name: laptop with Chrome and USB port
items.why: Runs the app and the micro:bit editor every week.

items.name: micro USB cable
items.why: Connects the micro:bit to the laptop to load each program.

items.name: micro:bit v2
items.why: The board the Build track programs every week, first with blocks then with Python.

items.name: Sprout ten-frames or an egg carton, and a small bag for stones
items.why: Teen numbers as a full ten with extras riding on top; the ten-stones walk needs something to carry.

items.name: Sprout: a second egg-carton ten-frame (household)
items.why: Counting past the teens and saying twenty as two whole tens.

items.name: breadboard starter kit
items.why: Jumper wires, LEDs, resistors, a button and a buzzer, for building real circuits by hand from week 3.

items.name: micro:bit edge connector breakout
items.why: The piece that lets the micro:bit reach a breadboard at all. Without it the board's pins cannot be wired up.

items.name: mBot v1.2 robot (already owned)
items.why: Drives the robot weeks: a square, then line following, then avoiding obstacles. Programmed in mBlock, which is Scratch-like, so it builds on the Scratch they have already done.

items.name: tablet or laptop with mic and webcam
items.why: Records the voice explain and Speak track recordings.

items.name: AA batteries for the mBot
items.why: The robot weeks; v1.2 eats batteries.

items.name: Black electrical tape and white poster board
items.why: Fresh line course for the creature's Roam mood in week 7 and the week 8 secret course.

items.name: Sprout coin purse with real small coins
items.why: The Market Day card: the younger child is the shop's first customer and counts three coins into the shopkeeper's hand.

items.name: Sprout seed cup, soil, fast seeds (beans)
items.why: Week 11 is plant week: the parent card plants a real seed with your child and says the four steps in order. The sprout is what they show at their own week 12 showcase, so the cup has to be in soil by week 11 or there is nothing to show.

items.name: multimeter
items.why: Reads a real voltage and a real current in the physics extras of weeks 3, 4 and 12. The circuit stops being a story once the child has measured it.

items.name: tape measure
items.why: Measures how far the sensor sees and how far the robot travels per wheel turn, in the physics extras of weeks 7 and 8.

items.name: piano or keyboard (already owned)
items.why: The Play track: instrument practice in four short sittings a week, only for a child whose Play track is turned on.

items.name: Set card deck
items.why: The season 1 sprint 1 game, needed by week 1.

items.name: Mastermind set
items.why: The season 1 sprint 2 game, needed by week 5.

items.name: Two pens in different colours for Dots and boxes
items.why: The season 1 sprint 3 game, needed by week 9; the dot grid itself is printed at no cost.
